token.description: The JSON Web Token (JWT) to be used as the `Token` header value in all subsequent API requests.

expires_at.description: The expiration date and time of the JWT token, in ISO 8601 format.

refresh_token.description: A token used to refresh the JWT token when it expires.

Response403Forbidden.description:
One of the following values will be returned in the `code` property:
 *   `INVALID_TOKEN`: The provided token is invalid
 *   `TOKEN_DEACTIVATED`: The token has been deactivated
 *   `TOKEN_EXPIRED`: The token has expired
 *   `NO_PERMISSION`: The account does not have permission

HeaderToken.name: Token
HeaderToken.description: The JWT token received from the `POST /auth` endpoint's response field name `token`. This should be included in the header as `Token: <JWT Token>`.
